request: Add per-Socials-account Agent Reach X session bindings

entries.note: Extended the existing non-secret per-account env-alias contract to select Agent Reach cookie key names without storing cookie values.
Reused the established names-only Shared Hive Env secret selector and saver for each account cookie.
Adapted twitter-cli canonical per-process TWITTER_AUTH_TOKEN and TWITTER_CT0 precedence into immutable account-scoped subprocess environments.
Reused presence-only env validation before persisting an account binding.
Extended the existing hermetic X engagement runner seam with concurrent account isolation and fail-closed credential cases.
